en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to gain knowledge of medical, aromatic and spice crops and the possibilities of their use for diverse processing areas with regard to quality. The objective is to acquire advanced knowledge that will enable critical understanding of medical and aromatic crops growing. Students will gain complex skills necessary for growing realization with consideration to quality and broad use of these species in different processing areas. The goal is to prepare students so that they are competent to independently manage growing and processing of medical and aromatic crops prior to delivery to the final processor.
